headline: System Failure Disrupts ATMs at 128 Shinkin Banks in Japan
summary: A system failure disrupted automated teller machine services across 128 Shinkin banks in Japan.
why: Operational disruptions in retail banking infrastructure impact customer transactions and highlight operational risk in legacy financial networks.

impacts.name: Japanese Banking
impacts.why: Network outages temporarily halt customer access to cash and banking transaction channels.
